Building the first paper…

Question bank

Every sub-domain gets a share of the bank equal to its share of the five real sittings (240 questions). Inside a sub-domain, the forms that came up more often get more questions. One question in five is one notch harder than the exam.

Course build

Everything the 56-day plan still needs written, in one run: Set A and Set B for the 33 lesson days, Set C for the 20 one-video days, weekly mocks W1–W7 and both versions of the 41–48 drills. No question is used twice anywhere in the build. Files use the website's import format, one per course week.

Question forms

A form is one kind of question the exam asks, written as a generator with its own answer check. Choose a row to see a sample.

Check a question file

Paste questions in the website's import format, or choose a JSON file. The check applies the import rules: ids, slots, points, levels, four different options, a stem that ends with “( )”, formulas that KaTeX can read, and the per-set rules.
